questions.question: How is the engagement score calculated?

validation.message: TypeScript metrics match the independent Python reference for the same dataset.

questions.answer:
Samsara Survey — Synthetic Data
Company-wide · 2024, 2025, 2026

• The custom Demo Company Engagement Score is a fictional metric, not an official Samsara metric. [engagement_score_definition.md]

• Respondent Score = ((QID1 + QID2 + QID3) / 3 - 1) × 25. [engagement_score_definition.md]

• Company Engagement Score = the arithmetic mean of all valid respondent scores. [engagement_score_definition.md]

• Every respondent has equal weight; do not average department averages. [engagement_score_definition.md]
2026 is YTD through October 21; no causal or significance claim is implied.
